title: Willdan Announces Date of Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Release and Conference Call
summary: The Investor Relations website contains information about Willdan Group, Inc.'s business for stockholders, potential investors, and financial analysts.
body_markdown:
ANAHEIM, Calif.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Oct. 6, 2026-- Willdan Group, Inc. (“Willdan”) (Nasdaq: WLDN), today announced that it will release its financial results for the third quarter 2026 after the close of the stock market on Thursday, November 5, 2026. Following the release, Willdan will host its investor conference call at 5:30 p.m. EST / 2:30 p.m. PST.


An online, real-time audio webcast of the quarterly investor conference call will be available on Willdan’s website at:[Willdan Group Q3 2026 Investor Conference Call](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fedge.media-server.com%2Fmmc%2Fp%2Fg9h8kboz%2F&esheet=54616872&newsitemid=20261006200894&lan=en-US&anchor=Willdan+Group+Q3+2026+Investor+Conference+Call&index=1&md5=a3aadec21eee6cd9dfaaf21cb8bfeb0d) . Alternatively, listeners may access the call by dialing 877-407-2988 (or 201-389-0923) at least five minutes prior to the 5:30 p.m. EDT / 2:30 p.m. PDT start time. An online replay of earnings webcast will be available a few hours after the completion of the call at[https://ir.willdangroup.com/events-presentations](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fir.willdangroup.com%2Fevents-presentations&esheet=54616872&newsitemid=20261006200894&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Fir.willdangroup.com%2Fevents-presentations&index=2&md5=6de9546a3752a5025a461ba467eb9866) .


**About Willdan**


Willdan is a technical services company focused on energy and infrastructure solutions. These solutions include energy planning and analytics, consulting, software, public finance, engineering, and program implementation. Willdan serves utilities, state and local governments, and commercial customers in the United States and Canada. For additional information, visit Willdan's website at[www.willdan.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.willdan.com&esheet=54616872&newsitemid=20261006200894&lan=en-US&anchor=www.willdan.com&index=3&md5=121fcd1156974a4cc47648e9aa49b4fb) .
